mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM kb_knowledge_base WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT count(*) FROM kb_knowledge_base kb WHERE kb.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND kb.status = 'ACTIVE' AND kb.deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kb_document_chunk chunk WHERE chunk.tenant_id = kb.tenant_id AND chunk.knowledge_base_id = kb.id AND chunk.status = 'ACTIVE' AND chunk.deleted_at IS NULL )

SELECT count(*) FROM kb_knowledge_base kb WHERE kb.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND kb.status = 'ACTIVE' AND kb.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kb_document_chunk chunk WHERE chunk.tenant_id = kb.tenant_id AND chunk.knowledge_base_id = kb.id AND chunk.status = 'ACTIVE' AND chunk.deleted_at IS NULL )
SELECT count(DISTINCT job.knowledge_base_id) FROM kb_embedding_job job WHERE job.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND job.status = 'FAILED' AND job.deleted_at IS NULL
